designationHistory.indexText: Big Oaks National Wildlife Refuge was established as an overlay refuge on the U.S. Army's former Jefferson Proving Ground in Indiana.

authority.citation: Overlay refuge on former Jefferson Proving Ground (U.S. Army) under a memorandum of agreement with the Army

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Big Oaks National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Big Oaks Conservation Society, "The Refuge": "In June 2000, Big Oaks National Wildlife Refuge was established"

review.note: June 2000 confirmed by the refuge Friends group; authority (Army MOA) from FWS and local reporting, exact day not found.
